meta.title: Submitting the same bid twice does not create a second active bid
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: the documented correct behaviour is a refusal, but the case checks only that the app does not crash (it records today's behaviour)

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “A bid has already been placed from your team”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Submitting the same bid twice does not create a second active bid
